static_traits.name: Wesley
static_traits.family_status: Having Algerian background, no other family details provided
static_traits.social_status: A few close friends to talk with, but not yet discussing financial anxiety with them; relationships with friends and family affected by constant money worries
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness history; never received psychotherapy or counseling before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, can do reality-testing and cognitive restructuring; showing marked anxiety when discussing financial issues, but positive attitude, high cooperativeness

basic_info.main_problem: Ongoing worry about going bankrupt because barista work is financially unstable, causing marked anxiety and stress; the problem worsened over the past six months and has affected sleep and diet routines.
basic_info.core_demands: With financial-related anxiety and stress constantly increasing, expecting support and coping strategies to ease anxiety and improve the situation.
growth_experiences: Six months ago after starting barista work, sustained financial anxiety formed from the job's financial instability; sleep disturbance and irregular diet followed, negatively affecting work performance and interpersonal relationships.

core_beliefs: My work is financially unstable and will eventually bankrupt me

special_situations.event: When checking the bank account balance or thinking of monthly bills
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If income and expenses do not match, I will soon run out of funds and be unable to afford basic needs
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overtime work, strict budgeting, cutting non-essential spending
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will soon run out of money and may become homeless

special_situations.event: Finding little remaining when settling the budget after payday
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the balance is low, it means finances are unsustainable, and any unexpected expense will destroy me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistent worry, repeatedly checks accounts to try to gain control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Just one unexpected expense and I will not be able to hold on

special_situations.event: When thinking about one's career prospects and current income stability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my current work is not stable or high-paying, I cannot maintain basic living
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Compensating for instability worries by taking more shifts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As a barista, I am destined to fail financially

special_situations.event: When reviewing the fact of always paying bills on time until now, still feels strong worry
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Even if nothing has gone wrong now, it does not mean the future is safe
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating positive signs, only focusing on negative data
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This positive evidence does not count, I will still go bankrupt

core_conflict.wish: Longing for financial security and stability, and controllability over the future
core_conflict.fear: Fear of losing basic living security, fear of becoming homeless
defense_goal: Lowering uncertainty and maintaining security through stronger self-control (budgeting, overtime, cutting expenses)
Gains a sense of control by repeatedly checking accounts and data

object_relations.self_representation: A financially insecure self who may go bankrupt at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A threatening and stressful external economic environment (bills and bank account numbers)

manifestations: Relationships with friends and family are strained by persistent money worries
Having close friends but not yet discussing financial anxiety with them, tending to bear it alone

contact_model.definition: An individual restraining the impulse to act toward others or things, or giving up seeking others to do something for them and instead doing it to oneself; turning outward-bound energy back toward oneself.
manifestations: Choosing to bear it alone rather than discussing financial anxiety with close friends
Turning the impulse to seek external support into self-overtime and self-restraint
Reducing direct expression and help-seeking during interpersonal tension

exception_events.target_problem: When checking finances and paying monthly bills, the client usually develops strong anxiety and predicts funds will run out, worrying about being unable to afford basic needs.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In the most recent billing period, the client still paid all bills on time; though the balance was low, funds never ran out, and realizing the fact 'still able to cover expenses so far' slightly eased anxiety.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: budgeting, overtime, and cutting non-essential expenses; different understanding: reality-testing confirmed funds never broke down yet, forming counter-evidence to the 'bankruptcy' prediction.

positive_force: Has self-management abilities (budgeting, overtime, cutting expenses)
So far able to pay bills on time, with basic financial maintenance ability
Willing to do reality testing and cognitive restructuring, positive attitude
Having a few close friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Unhealthy cognitive patterns like catastrophizing, predicting the future, black-and-white, and negating positive evidence continuously reinforcing anxiety
Long-term financial anxiety causing sleep and diet disturbance, work performance and interpersonal relationships affected
Tending to bear pressure alone, not yet actively using social support

target_behavior.behavior: Strong anxiety and catastrophic predictions in financial situations (fearing bankruptcy, homelessness)
antecedent: Thinking about monthly bills and expenses
Little balance left when settling the budget after payday
target_behavior.core_reason: Seeing barista work as financially unstable, with cognitive distortions like catastrophizing, predicting the future, black-and-white, and negating positive evidence, leading to excessive worry about financial failure
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain control through excessive worry and monitoring, escaping uncertainty and perceived potential financial danger
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbed, irregular diet; work performance affected; relationship tension with friends and family
